r: support.message: this tracker is for patch bugs. a patch misbehaving is a bug report, general support isn't

r: app-side.message: the unpatched app does this too, so it isn't a patch. if the patched build behaves differently, comment with the difference

r: not-this-bundle.message: that APK wasn't patched with this bundle. patch it with this bundle in Morphe Manager or morphe-cli and report again if it still happens

r: app-updated.message: this app version isn't targeted yet. this issue tracks it, a listed version works meanwhile

r: server-side.message: the server enforces this, the APK has nothing to patch

r: no-repro.message: can't reproduce this yet. add the exact steps and the patch list from the app's entry in Morphe Manager

r: fixed.message: possible fix committed. comment if it still happens once the next release is out

r: not-a-bug.message: this doesn't look like a patch bug. comment if something suggests otherwise

r: shipped.message:
🎉 **Shipped in {latest_release}** 🎉
Update the bundle in Morphe Manager and repatch.
